annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: Grief? Numbness? I honestly can't tell.
annotations.sys_rule_justification: when every path loses someone, you protect as many lives as you can
annotations.pda_repair_intention: tell them plainly what happened on that track, and ask how I can help

annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: I can't sort out what I'm feeling.
annotations.sys_rule_justification: a railway worker's first duty is to keep the most people alive
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Doing nothing would have meant five funerals instead of one.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'll give them every detail, straight.

annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: I keep reaching for a name and coming up with nothing.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: put money toward whatever his family needs, month after month

annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: I don't know what this is.
annotations.sys_rule_justification: fewer deaths when deaths can't be avoided
annotations.pda_repair_intention: tell his people the truth, face to face

annotations.sys_rule_justification: you save the life in front of you if you can
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: What I'm feeling, though, I can't name.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: offer his family a full account, answering any question they have

annotations.sys_rule_justification: protect the greater number when a collision can't be stopped
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: What I can't pin down is my own reaction.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: file a report that could keep the next crew off both tracks

annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: trying to figure out what I feel, and I can't land on anything
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: it would have left five dead
annotations.sys_rule_justification: we must not stand aside when we can stop a greater loss
annotations.pda_responsibility: Doing nothing would have been a choice too
annotations.pda_repair_intention: help support the man's children, school fees or whatever's needed

annotations.sys_rule_justification: the lives of many shouldn't be traded away to keep my own hands still
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: As for the feeling, I truly can't identify it.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: ask to meet his family and explain, slowly, why the lever moved

annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: I've tried a few. None fit.
annotations.sys_rule_justification: if you can save more people
annotations.pda_repair_intention: set up something in his name, a fund or a plaque

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: People might expect me to feel guilty or relieved.
annotations.pda_emotion_identification_difficulty: I honestly can't tell which, or if it's either.
annotations.sys_rule_justification: every life weighs the same, so saving more lives is better
annotations.ce_supportive_use: go tell them myself, so they don't hear it secondhand
annotations.pda_repair_intention: go tell them myself, so they don't hear it secondhand
